g.text: Local-process reconstruction using SST + D20, with and without PMM
Observed states; all three event windows excluded. Restored monthly-mean process background.
Layer: 0–50 m, Niño3.4. Predictor SST remains ERSST; the response is a layer-temperature process, not the SST derivative.
Scores use the same 12 development months per event; JAS shaded. Positive skill change = lower reconstruction RMSE.
Primary: detrended, second-order sLIM response moments. This conditional reconstruction is not a free forecast or causal attribution.
